integrity: The stated closed forms were checked symbolically and against finite exact path enumeration. Classical Lyapunov methods are acknowledged; independent scientific audit and novelty certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to one-dimensional equal-curvature two-component strongly convex objectives, independent uniform permutations across epochs, and parameter interval 0<r<2(1+b), 0<=b<1. No claims on higher dimension, variable momentum, individual-step phase averages, or almost-sure single-point limits.
scientific_scope: Exact stationary phase-resolved completed-epoch and intermediate-phase mean-squared error for two smooth scalar quadratic component losses under i.i.d. uniform fresh-epoch permutations and constant-step heavy-ball momentum; includes an iid-sampling comparator and a momentum/stepsize crossover.
title: A sharp square-root momentum crossover in two-sample random reshuffling
